mapper.select: SELECT scenario_node_no, version_no, node_key, node_type, title, content, sort_order, metadata::text AS metadata, frst_reg_dt, lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_node WHERE version_no = #{versionId} ORDER BY sort_order, scenario_node_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario_node (version_no, node_key, node_type, title, content, sort_order, metadata) VALUES (#{versionNo}, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{sortOrder}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb))
